maddeler.e:
نلتبن (form VIII)
# نَلْتَبِنُ (naltabinu) /nal.ta.bi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَنَ (iltabana)
# نَلْتَبِنَ (naltabina) /nal.ta.bi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَبَنَ (iltabana)
# نَلْتَبِنْ (naltabin) /nal.ta.bin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْتَبَنَ (iltabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
